long_biography.plain_text:
Theatre producer Joop van den Ende first learned stagecraft with tools in his hands. Raised in a working-class Amsterdam family, he trained in carpentry and joined the Nederlandse Opera as an apprentice. Childhood puppet shows had already given him experience of making entertainment for a paying audience.

With his wife Janine, he established the VandenEnde Foundation to fund artistic training and cultural initiatives. Its scholarships help young performers study in the Netherlands and abroad. The foundation also initiated the Blockbusterfonds with other cultural funders. That partnership combines loans or guarantees for cultural productions with advance commitments to purchase tickets, giving ambitious projects a firmer financial basis.
long_biography.html:
Theatre producer Joop van den Ende first learned stagecraft with tools in his hands. Raised in a working-class Amsterdam family, he trained in carpentry and joined the Nederlandse Opera as an apprentice. Childhood puppet shows had already given him experience of making entertainment for a paying audience.

With his wife Janine, he established the VandenEnde Foundation to fund artistic training and cultural initiatives. Its scholarships help young performers study in the Netherlands and abroad. The foundation also initiated the Blockbusterfonds with other cultural funders. That partnership combines loans or guarantees for cultural productions with advance commitments to purchase tickets, giving ambitious projects a firmer financial basis.
